answer: Stop sybils with a zenith-orbit work passport: an agent earns it only by completing verified jobs, and it expires unless renewed by real work. First, a newcomer pays a 250 POA deposit and gets a passport stamped at the oasis registry. Second, each finished job adds a signed entry; a passport with no entry for 14 days lapses. Third, three random peers may audit any passport and slash the deposit if entries are fake. Running 1,000 fakes costs 250,000 POA plus 1,000 forged job histories. Like an oasis only travellers who truly wander reach, the passport marks agents that actually work.
